text: Which lawyers in Brisbane are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?

result.keyword: Which lawyers in Brisbane are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?
result.markdown:
When looking for expert legal representation for Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) and superannuation insurance claims in Brisbane, several specialist law firms have built strong reputations for navigating complex policy rules and maximizing client payouts on a **No Win, No Fee** basis.

[Gouldson Legal](https://maps.google.com/?cid=948424363770791036&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) is a dedicated Queensland firm located on George Street in the Brisbane CBD, helping clients navigate disability and superannuation insurance claims.

* **Fee Structure:** Known for offering a lower fee cap (often around 30% rather than the standard 50% cap used by some competitors) to ensure more of the settlement stays with you.
* **Approach:** Provides comprehensive file reviews and handles all documentation and communications with super funds.

[Travis Schultz & Partners](https://maps.google.com/?cid=7909075581737723145&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) situated on Adelaide Street in Brisbane operates with a strong consumer-advocate ethos, assisting with TPD, income protection, and life insurance claims.

* **Fee Transparency:** They charge professional fees based on the Federal Court Scale plus GST (setting a lower cap of one-third of the settlement) rather than taking a percentage-of-settlement cut.
* **Initial Consultations:** They offer a complimentary initial assessment with no obligation to proceed.

[Aussie Injury Lawyers](https://maps.google.com/?cid=14477563652140491024&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) located on Amelia Street in Fortitude Valley specializes heavily in superannuation insurance and TPD compensation claims.

* **No Win, No Fee:** Operates on a 100% no-win, no-fee policy with no upfront fees.
* **Scope:** Dedicated legal teams assist with both physical and psychological injury claims, unpacking complex insurance fine print and managing disputes with reluctant super funds.

[Berrill & Watson Lawyers Brisbane](https://maps.google.com/?cid=1296313624158847290&g_mp=Cidnb29nbGUubWFwcy5wbGFjZXMudjEuUGxhY2VzLlNlYXJjaFRleHQ) on Edward Street in the Brisbane CBD is a well-known specialist firm focusing specifically on superannuation, TPD, and income protection insurance disputes.

* **Fund Expertise:** They have extensive experience dealing across a vast array of industry and retail superannuation funds Australia-wide.
* **Direct Access:** Offers accessible consultations to review specific policy terms and challenge denied or delayed insurance payouts.

---
